# SMART Sniffer App (Home Assistant OS App)

> SMART Sniffer App is a Home Assistant OS App that watches the drives of the machine
> Home Assistant runs on: the boot SSD or NVMe, the data disk, and any USB drive Home
> Assistant mounts. It runs the SMART Sniffer agent inside the App, judges every drive
> with the SMART Sniffer integration's own rules, and shows this box's drives, read only,
> on its own page ("SMART Sniffer App" in the sidebar). The SMART Sniffer HACS
> integration (v0.9+) turns the data into Home Assistant entities and has the Control
> Center for every machine.

Better together: the integration owns every machine, and its Control Center (a "SMART
Sniffer" sidebar page for admins) shows them all. The App adds the drives of the box
Home Assistant runs on, which no outside agent can reach. Other machines run the
standalone agent from the smart-sniffer repo.

Key behaviors:
- Reads S.M.A.R.T. data with smartctl inside the App's container. Needs SYS_RAWIO and
  SYS_ADMIN plus full_access to drive device nodes, all set by the App. On some
  hardware, Protection Mode must be off (Settings -> Apps -> SMART Sniffer App ->
  Protection mode).
- Ships the agent and the rule modules of the integration release named by SS_TAG in
  its Dockerfile (v0.9.0 for App 0.4.x), never "latest".
- The agent listens on port 9099 at the App's container host name (for example
  0449a086-smart-sniffer-agent) and advertises itself with mDNS under a name unique
  per Home Assistant instance (smartha-<ha-hostname>).
- With integration v0.9+ installed, posts a Supervisor discovery (service
  smart_sniffer, host and port only), so Home Assistant offers this box as "SMART
  Sniffer (HAOS)". The App's page also has "Create sensors and alerts for HAOS". The box
  is never added twice. Manual fallback: the host and port from the App's log line
  "Integration host:".
- The page shows one card per drive, ZFS pool and filesystem of this box, with a stat
  row (temperature, days powered on, data written and read, wear), disk space, a health
  word (Attention, Maybe, Health OK, Health not known) with the rows behind it, and
  Details (model, serial, firmware, capacity, interface, SMART attributes, Device
  Statistics). It refreshes every 30 seconds. A card under the drives opens the
  integration's Control Center, or says how to install, update or finish updating it.
- Disk space covers USB drives mounted under /media (read only) and the data disk, also
  after "Move data disk". Mounts are found when the App starts.
- The page answers only Home Assistant's ingress. The Bearer Token option is a password
  field and is never put on a command line.
- App 0.4.0 hands the machines App 0.3.x kept (address, port, password, names, hidden
  cards, order, thresholds) to integration v0.9+ once, and removes each from its
  options when the integration confirms it.
- Replicas (test drives) and Agentic access moved to the integration in App 0.4.0 /
  integration v0.9. The App no longer runs a replica agent.

Supported architectures: amd64, aarch64. armv7 was dropped in v0.2.12.

Configuration options:
- Agent Port (default: 9099)
- Bearer Token (optional, must match the integration's entry for this box)
- Scan Interval in seconds (default: 60)
- Field Agents, Card Order, Hidden Cards, Thresholds, Card Names, Machine Names: what
  App 0.3.x kept. Field machines' entries are handed to the integration and removed;
  this box's thresholds still judge its cards on the App's page.

What this App is NOT:
- Not an agent for other machines -- install the standalone Go agent from smart-sniffer
  on a NAS, Proxmox host, workstation or Mac, and add it in the integration's Control
  Center.
- Not a replacement for the integration -- the App's page shows this box without it,
  but other machines, entities, history, notifications, automations and replicas come
  from the SMART Sniffer HACS integration.
- Not on HACS -- install it by adding this repo to the Home Assistant App Store.
- Not useful inside a VM -- there it sees only the virtual disk, which usually has no
  SMART data. Install the agent on the host instead.

## Repositories

- [smart-sniffer-app (this repo)](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app):
  the App (smart_sniffer_agent/), its read-only page (smart_sniffer_agent/web/), and
  the App Store repository file (repository.yaml).
- [smart-sniffer](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer): primary repo. HACS
  integration, standalone Go agent for other machines, and the project documentation.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/README.md):
  what the App does, App or integration, installation, configuration, upgrading from
  0.3.x, how it works, security and permissions, troubleshooting.
- [DOCS](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/smart_sniffer_agent/DOCS.md):
  the App's Documentation tab in Home Assistant: the page, the card under the drives,
  configuration, a dashboard card, Protection Mode, troubleshooting.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  release history.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  how the App is built, the page's dev harness, tests.

## Optional

- [SMART Sniffer llms.txt](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer/blob/main/llms.txt):
  full project context: agent architecture, entity reference, Attention Needed
  classification logic, supported drive types, and design rationale.
